name: weekly-vault-cleanup
steps: Clean up (lint) the Obsidian vault at <vault-path>, following AGENTS.md, including its writing and linking rules.
Don't touch the bot-owned folder (<bot-folder>); the daily compliance pass handles it (index links are fine).
Start with a backup: a git commit, or a copy at _backup/<date> outside the synced folder or excluded from sync.
Skip any note edited in the last 24 hours.
Fix and fill properties, normalize tags, add cross-links, fix broken links and update the index pages.

Sweep for stale or hard-to-read summaries, topic mentions that should be inline links, and notes holding content that belongs elsewhere; add missing inline links directly and put summary rewrites and content moves in a proposal note.
Flag duplicates, contradictions and stale notes, but don't merge them.
Big rewrites, merges, moves, renames, deletes and layout changes go into the proposal note with a short message to the user, and happen only after approval.
Check the sync log at the end.
Message the user only when there are proposals or notable fixes.
Journal every run, skips included, as the thin routine prompt says; the line's read: field must include `routine:weekly-vault-cleanup.json`.
